parsed.explanation: The quoted sentence is the entire content of the B≠∅ case of the refinement lemma's upper bound: the overlay/common-refinement pairing and the crucial count of at most q−1 = n cuts are asserted with 'standard; details omitted'. This is exactly the mechanism L3.2 requires (mirrored cuts pairing S against T, bisect the rest, within the budget). Elsewhere the text only handles B=∅ (bisect outside A, q−|A| cuts), remarks that overlay cuts lie interior and coincidences reduce the count, and then invokes the lemma in Section 3. No passage carries out the B≠∅ construction or verifies its cut budget, so the universal upper bound is not established as written; supplying the omitted construction is a lemma-sized repair.
